meta.status: sample dialogues written for Hanzee; speakers are the mascots Bao (宝宝) and Kopi (可比). Need editorial review.

lines.speaker: bao
lines.hanzi: 你好！我叫宝宝。你叫什么名字？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Bǎobao. Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
lines.en: Hi! I'm Bao. What's your name?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.hanzi: 你好！我叫可比。认识你很高兴。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Kěbǐ. Rènshi nǐ hěn gāoxìng.
lines.id: Halo! Namaku Kopi. Senang berkenalan denganmu.
lines.en: Hi! I'm Kopi. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shì xuésheng ma?
lines.en: Are you a student?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Shì, wǒ shì xuésheng. Nǐ ne?
lines.en: Yes, I'm a student. And you?

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě shì xuésheng!
lines.en: I'm a student too!

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Bǎobao, xiànzài jǐ diǎn?
lines.en: Bao, what time is it?

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài sān diǎn.
lines.en: It's three o'clock.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān xīngqī jǐ?
lines.en: What day is it today?

lines.speaker: bao
lines.hanzi: 今天星期五。明天星期六！
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān xīngqīwǔ. Míngtiān xīngqīliù!
lines.id: Hari ini hari Jumat. Besok hari Sabtu!
lines.en: Today is Friday. Tomorrow is Saturday!

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Kěbǐ, nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ ge rén?
lines.en: Kopi, how many people are in your family?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.hanzi: 我家有四个人：爸爸、妈妈、我和女儿。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu sì ge rén: bàba, māma, wǒ hé nǚ'ér.
lines.id: Keluargaku ada empat orang: ayah, ibu, aku, dan anak perempuan.
lines.en: There are four of us: dad, mom, me and my daughter.

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jiā yǒu māo ma?
lines.en: Do you have a cat at home?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.hanzi: 没有猫，我们有一个小狗。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu māo, wǒmen yǒu yí ge xiǎo gǒu.
lines.id: Tidak ada kucing, kami punya seekor anjing kecil.
lines.en: No cat, we have a little dog.

question.en: How many people are in Kopi's family?

question.id: Hewan apa yang ada di rumah Kopi?
question.en: What pet does Kopi's family have?

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Píngguǒ duōshao qián?
lines.en: Hello! How much are the apples?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Yí ge píngguǒ sān kuài qián.
lines.en: Three yuan each.

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi wǔ ge.
lines.en: I'd like five.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, shíwǔ kuài. Xièxie!
lines.id: Baik, lima belas yuan. Terima kasih!
lines.en: Okay, fifteen yuan. Thank you!

question.en: How many apples does Bao buy?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de shū ne?
lines.en: Where's my book?

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de shū zài zhuōzi shang.
lines.en: Your book is on the table.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Zhuōzi shang méiyǒu shū.
lines.id: Di atas meja tidak ada buku.
lines.en: There's no book on the table.

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zài yǐzi xiàmiàn!
lines.en: Look, it's under the chair!

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: How's the weather today?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān hěn lěng, xià yǔ le.
lines.en: It's cold today, and it's raining.

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen zài jiā kàn diànyǐng ba.
lines.id: Kita nonton film di rumah saja.
lines.en: Let's watch a movie at home.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le!
lines.en: Great idea!

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jiějie jīntiān zěnme méi lái?
lines.id: Kenapa kakakmu tidak datang hari ini?
lines.en: Why didn't your sister come today?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Tā shēngbìng le, zài jiā xiūxi.
lines.id: Dia sakit, sedang istirahat di rumah.
lines.en: She's sick and resting at home.

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Tā chī yào le ma?
lines.en: Has she taken medicine?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Chī le. Tā bǐ zuótiān hǎo duō le.
lines.id: Sudah. Dia jauh lebih baik dari kemarin.
lines.en: Yes. She's much better than yesterday.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.hanzi: 这个红色的手机多少钱？
lines.pinyin: Zhège hóngsè de shǒujī duōshao qián?
lines.en: How much is this red phone?

lines.speaker: bao
lines.hanzi: 两千块。白色的便宜一点儿。
lines.pinyin: Liǎngqiān kuài. Báisè de piányi yìdiǎnr.
lines.id: Dua ribu yuan. Yang putih sedikit lebih murah.
lines.en: Two thousand yuan. The white one is a bit cheaper.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.hanzi: 太贵了！我买过一个黑色的，很好用。
lines.pinyin: Tài guì le! Wǒ mǎi guo yí ge hēisè de, hěn hǎoyòng.
lines.id: Mahal sekali! Aku pernah beli yang hitam, enak dipakai.
lines.en: Too expensive! I've bought a black one before, it worked well.

question.en: How much is the red phone?

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Nǐ měitiān jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng?
lines.id: Kamu bangun jam berapa setiap hari?
lines.en: What time do you get up every day?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.hanzi: 六点。我早上跑步，晚上游泳。
lines.pinyin: Liù diǎn. Wǒ zǎoshang pǎobù, wǎnshang yóuyǒng.
lines.id: Jam enam. Pagi aku lari, malam aku berenang.
lines.en: Six. I run in the morning and swim in the evening.

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yóu de hěn kuài ma?
lines.en: Do you swim fast?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.hanzi: 还可以。我正在学打篮球呢！
lines.pinyin: Hái kěyǐ. Wǒ zhèngzài xué dǎ lánqiú ne!
lines.id: Lumayan. Aku juga sedang belajar main basket!
lines.en: Not bad. I'm learning basketball right now!

question.en: What time does Kopi get up?

question.id: Apa yang Kopi lakukan pada malam hari?
question.en: What does Kopi do in the evening?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Zǎoshang nǐ chī shénme?
lines.en: What do you eat in the morning?

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Liǎng ge jīdàn, hē yì bēi niúnǎi.
lines.en: Two eggs and a glass of milk.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen zěnme qù jīchǎng?
lines.en: How are we getting to the airport?

lines.speaker: bao
lines.hanzi: 因为下雪了，所以坐公共汽车吧。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi xià xuě le, suǒyǐ zuò gōnggòng qìchē ba.
lines.id: Karena turun salju, kita naik bus saja.
lines.en: It's snowing, so let's take the bus.

question.en: Why do they take the bus?

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Bīngxiāng li yǒu shénme?
lines.en: What's in the fridge?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.hanzi: 有面包、香蕉和一个蛋糕。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu miànbāo, xiāngjiāo hé yí ge dàngāo.
lines.id: Ada roti, pisang, dan sebuah kue.
lines.en: There's bread, bananas and a cake.

lines.speaker: bao
lines.hanzi: 我把蛋糕放在盘子里吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ dàngāo fàng zài pánzi li ba.
lines.id: Aku taruh kuenya di piring ya.
lines.en: I'll put the cake on a plate.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Hǎo! Zài ná liǎng shuāng kuàizi.
lines.id: Oke! Ambil juga dua pasang sumpit.
lines.en: Okay! Grab two pairs of chopsticks too.

question.id: Apa saja yang ada di kulkas?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de xīn qúnzi zhēn piàoliang!
lines.en: Your new skirt is really pretty!

lines.speaker: bao
lines.hanzi: 谢谢！我喜欢蓝色的。你的帽子呢？
lines.pinyin: Xièxie! Wǒ xǐhuan lánsè de. Nǐ de màozi ne?
lines.id: Terima kasih! Aku suka yang biru. Topimu mana?
lines.en: Thanks! I like blue ones. Where is your hat?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.hanzi: 在这儿，是黄色的。天气越来越热了。
lines.pinyin: Zài zhèr, shì huángsè de. Tiānqì yuè lái yuè rè le.
lines.id: Ini, warnanya kuning. Cuaca makin lama makin panas.
lines.en: Here, it's yellow. It's getting hotter and hotter.

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Gōngyuán li de huā kāi le!
lines.en: The flowers in the park are blooming!

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen yìbiān zǒu yìbiān kàn ba.
lines.en: Let's look around while we walk.

lines.speaker: bao
lines.hanzi: 河边有很多树，太阳也很好。
lines.pinyin: Hé biān yǒu hěn duō shù, tàiyang yě hěn hǎo.
lines.id: Di tepi sungai banyak pohon, mataharinya juga cerah.
lines.en: There are lots of trees by the river, and the sun is lovely.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.hanzi: 下午我们去图书馆看书。
lines.pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǒmen qù túshūguǎn kàn shū.
lines.id: Sore nanti kita ke perpustakaan membaca.
lines.en: This afternoon we'll go read at the library.

question.id: Ke mana mereka pergi sore hari?
question.en: Where will they go in the afternoon?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, xióngmāo zài chī zhúzi!
lines.en: Look, the panda is eating bamboo!

lines.speaker: bao
lines.hanzi: 它的耳朵和眼睛都是黑的。
lines.pinyin: Tā de ěrduo hé yǎnjing dōu shì hēi de.
lines.en: Its ears and eyes are black.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.hanzi: 哎呀，我的面包被鸟吃了！
lines.pinyin: Āiyā, wǒ de miànbāo bèi niǎo chī le!
lines.en: Oh no, a bird ate my bread!

question.id: Apa yang terjadi pada roti Kopi?

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yǐhòu xiǎng zuò shénme gōngzuò?
lines.id: Nanti kamu ingin bekerja sebagai apa?
lines.en: What job do you want in the future?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.hanzi: 我想当护士。我不但喜欢帮助别人，而且对医学很感兴趣。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng dāng hùshi. Wǒ búdàn xǐhuan bāngzhù biérén, érqiě duì yīxué hěn gǎn xìngqù.
lines.id: Aku ingin jadi perawat. Aku bukan hanya suka membantu orang, tetapi juga tertarik pada ilmu kedokteran.
lines.en: I want to be a nurse. I not only like helping people, I'm also interested in medicine.

lines.speaker: bao
lines.hanzi: 我想当演员，也想当警察！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng dāng yǎnyuán, yě xiǎng dāng jǐngchá!
lines.id: Aku ingin jadi aktor, juga ingin jadi polisi!
lines.en: I want to be an actor, and a police officer too!

question.en: What does Kopi want to be?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.hanzi: 我的钥匙呢？我连沙发下面都找了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de yàoshi ne? Wǒ lián shāfā xiàmiàn dōu zhǎo le.
lines.id: Kunciku mana? Aku bahkan sudah mencari di bawah sofa.
lines.en: Where are my keys? I've even looked under the sofa.

lines.speaker: bao
lines.hanzi: 窗户旁边的桌子上看了吗？
lines.pinyin: Chuānghu pángbiān de zhuōzi shang kàn le ma?
lines.id: Sudah lihat di meja dekat jendela?
lines.en: Did you check the table by the window?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Zhǎodào le! Xièxie nǐ!
lines.en: Found them! Thank you!

options.en: On the table by the window

lines.speaker: bao
lines.hanzi: 即使很忙，你也每天写汉字吗？
lines.pinyin: Jíshǐ hěn máng, nǐ yě měitiān xiě Hànzì ma?
lines.id: Meskipun sibuk, kamu tetap menulis Hanzi setiap hari?
lines.en: Even when busy, do you write characters every day?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.hanzi: 对。我把生词写在笔记本上，不认识的字就查词典。
lines.pinyin: Duì. Wǒ bǎ shēngcí xiě zài bǐjìběn shang, bú rènshi de zì jiù chá cídiǎn.
lines.id: Iya. Aku menulis kata baru di buku catatan, huruf yang belum kukenal kucari di kamus.
lines.en: Yes. I write new words in my notebook and look up unknown characters in the dictionary.

question.id: Apa yang Kopi lakukan dengan huruf yang belum dikenal?
question.en: What does Kopi do with unknown characters?

options.en: Looks them up in the dictionary

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān zuò tǔdòu hé huángguā ba.
lines.id: Hari ini kita masak kentang dan mentimun yuk.
lines.en: Let's cook potatoes and cucumber today.

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Yào fàng làjiāo ma?
lines.en: Should we add chili?

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.pinyin: Nándào nǐ bú pà là ma?
lines.en: Don't tell me you're not afraid of spicy food?

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan là de!
lines.en: Spicy is my favorite!

question.en: What does Bao want to add?

lines.speaker: bao
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de wòshì zhēn dà!
lines.en: Your bedroom is really big!

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.hanzi: 是我哥哥设计的，他是工程师。
lines.pinyin: Shì wǒ gēge shèjì de, tā shì gōngchéngshī.
lines.id: Kakakku yang merancangnya, dia seorang insinyur.
lines.en: My older brother designed it, he is an engineer.

lines.speaker: bao
lines.hanzi: 既然这么好，我就常来玩儿吧！
lines.pinyin: Jìrán zhème hǎo, wǒ jiù cháng lái wánr ba!
lines.id: Karena sebagus ini, aku akan sering main ke sini!
lines.en: Since it's this nice, I'll come over often!
